reasons: Prerequisites for CS4236 (CS2107) are not met; CS2107 is not in the required list and has no prerequisites listed that are completed, making CS4236 ineligible.
CS2109S requires MA1511/MA1512 or MA1521/MA2002 etc. MA1521 is completed. CS2040S is completed. Prerequisites met.

CS4234 requires MA2001/MA1101R etc. and YSC3203/CS3230. CS3230 is planned in Sem 4, so CS4234 cannot be in Sem 3 as CS3230 is a prerequisite. This creates a conflict with the hard constraint 'CS4234 has to be in semester 3'.

CS4225 requires CS2102 or IT2002. Neither is completed or planned. CS2102 requires CS2030S (completed) and CS1231/MA1100 etc. (CS1231S completed). So CS2102 is eligible. CS2102 must be taken before CS4225.
